_comment: Designer file. Adding a power is a row here. Adding a KIND of power is one class in BuiltinEffects.cpp plus one reg.add(...) line. Tier is not assigned per mission: the Director measures each mission's completion probability at offer time and that picks the tier, so retuning a mission moves its reward automatically.

powers.title: Reroll
powers.desc: Throw your roll away and roll again

powers.title: -3 Rival
powers.desc: A rival's next roll is 3 lower

powers.title: Shield
powers.desc: Your tokens cannot be captured for 3 turns

powers._note: Overpowered by design, so epic only. Respects star and start squares: those eight cells are the one safety guarantee the game makes, and an item that ignores them deletes the counterplay.
powers.title: Send Home
powers.desc: Send a rival token back to its yard

powers.title: Swap
powers.desc: Trade places with a rival token

powers.title: Skip Turn
powers.desc: A rival misses their next turn

powers._note: progress 50 is the last shared-track square, i.e. the mouth of your home lane.
powers.title: Jump Home
powers.desc: Send one of your tokens to your home lane
